methodology.coverage_unit: An executable rule predicate covers a contract when it distinguishes the required Kubernetes state from its documented negative case.
methodology.coverage_limit: Predicate coverage does not claim that a standalone tool emits the evaluator evidence envelope, handles approval-bound repairs, or passes the scenario end to end.
methodology.unsure: Source or fixture ambiguity prevents a decision, including inventory units that still require predicate decomposition.
methodology.uncovered: A reviewed rule is related but misses required behavior, or no current scenario covers that inventory rule.
methodology.no_applicable_rule: The tool has no inventoried rule targeting the contract behavior.
methodology.combined_coverage: A scenario is covered when at least one tool is covered. Tool percentages are not added because tools overlap on scenarios.
methodology.generated_variants: Generated descendants inherit their parent evaluator contract; row percentages weight every active scenario equally.
